role: Layer 4 reasoning interface to the knowledge graph: eight read queries that return typed node/edge sets from graph persistence.
detail: Provides eight public async query functions: get_current_scene() returns active Instance nodes (schema_level=INSTANCE, valid_to=None); get_changes_since(since) returns nodes created or confirmed after a timestamp; get_spatial_relationships(node_id) returns all incident edges; get_object_history(node_id) returns node versions (zero or one in single-ID model); get_type_instances(type_node_id) returns Instance nodes linked via INSTANCE_OF edges; get_schema_types() returns all SCHEMA-level nodes; get_pending_proposals() returns nodes with status=PENDING; get_untyped_instances() returns Instance nodes with no outgoing INSTANCE_OF edge. Internal helpers _get_edges_for_node and _get_all_edges wrap persistence.query_edges(). All queries honor temporal semantics (valid_to=None for active) and follow CANON A.10 (retain superseded states). Edge filtering uses Python-side OR logic because EdgeFilter only supports AND. Functions do not mutate returned objects (caller responsibility).
constants: schema_level filtering uses SchemaLevel.INSTANCE and SchemaLevel.SCHEMA
gotchas: get_object_history returns zero or one node per ID (single-node-per-ID model); version chains use SUPERSEDES edges not this query. Edge queries fail gracefully to empty list if persistence backend lacks query_edges method. Documentation notes get_untyped_instances returns all instances if edge queries unsupported (conservative). Comment at line 209 acknowledges this may be historical artifact.
